suspected_rule_gaps: SCAFFOLD: typed search text is appended to the prefilled Magento search box instead of replacing it — detect q_after == q_before + typed_text on catalogsearch URLs. Across all shopping runs this matches 1324 of about 3,700 type actions into a prefilled box (almost all via element_id_locator_route). Another 1341 cases leave the query unchanged, which is worth checking. Only B1_phantom_text 428 in this sample, where it did not cause the failure.

ENV STATE: the wishlist accumulates across tasks (start-of-task counts seen: 5 to 47 items). Flag page_image_query tasks whose eval_image_url is /wishlist/ (10 per page) when the start-of-task wishlist count is 10 or more, and program_html '?limit=50' wishlist tasks when it is 50 or more. All 4 wishlist image tasks (108/159/160/163) are 0/36 across runs; also check whether the selector '.products-grid .wishlist .product-image-photo' (descendant form) matches anything.

LISTING DRIFT: for intents with positional references (first/second/last row or column, Nth product), check whether the eval's must_include product name (or reference price) appears in the step_000 observation or screenshot at that position; if it is missing, mark the task unsatisfiable on the page served rather than an agent failure.
BUY WITHOUT ORDER: intent contains 'buy'/'order'/'purchase', agent_finished=true, and no step reached checkout/onepage/success.

OVERSHOOT ORDER: intent says 'before placing the order' (or eval url_match is checkout/#payment) but a step reached checkout/onepage/success. Also flag it as store-state pollution for later 'latest order' evals.

HEADER-WISHLIST CONFUSION: intent says 'add ... to my wish list', and a click on a product page navigates to /wishlist/ (header link) rather than /wishlist/index/index/wishlist_id/... (add result); flag 2 or more repeats as a loop.

LEFT DEICTIC PAGE: intent contains 'this page'/'on this page'/'this'/'first row'/'these', and within the first 2 steps the agent types into the site search box or clicks a top-level category, so the start URL is never revisited.
FACET-AS-ANSWER: the final answer's price string matches a sidebar price-filter label ('$X.00 - $Y.99' or '$X and above') on the final page.

SELF-CONTRADICTION: the agent's thought states a value that breaks the constraint it just quoted (price outside 'between $A-$B', 'exactly 4, not greater than 4', 'not fully visible ... appears to be').
